scope: Actual pixels in all ten candidate assets, including two uniformly resized/padded existing starter derivatives and eight newly generated higher-tier illustrations.
findings: All five Map silhouettes are distinct: flat folds, two unequal peaks, open arch, stepped cascade, three-tower citadel.
Teacup retains the gold-handled cream bowl; plain cup, single blue curl, outward paired curls, filled fan and open ribbon loops remain distinct.
Family palette and paper material language are coherent, with accurate catalog descriptions.
Fine colored flecks visible at master scale were not materially visible in native-size composites.
Cobalt and teal steam have reduced contrast on dark teal; both remain clear on the light board-style background.
limits: These are native-size asset composites, not rendered game screenshots or native-device evidence. Browser layout, image loading, interaction and actual exported postcards remain gated.
